title: RaidON
description: This library is designed to create raids or invasions for modpacks, with convenient configuration and documentation inside.
body:
###  **THIS IS A ALPHA VERSION OF LIBRARY!!!**

**If you found a bug, error or suggestion for improvement, plz write me about it in  [discord](https://discord.gg/5NSxKrA8tN)**

You can use this library to create raids and invasions in your modpacks, the exact documentation and examples of configs are on the [github](https://github.com/Xaoser/RaidON).


Do you want to make a zombie apocalypse or just make some kind of event?, then this library is just for you!, here you can even make an invasion of **CHICKENS!**
